toolchain-doctor.description: Read-only Rocky environment and required-tool availability check.
arguments: set -e; echo '== OS =='; cat /etc/os-release; echo '== Tools =='; command -v python3; python3 --version; for tool in vcs dc_shell vivado; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s=' "$tool"; command -v "$tool"; else printf '%s=NOT_FOUND\n' "$tool"; fi; done

vcs-install-audit.description: Read-only VCS alias, selected-home, and installed-compiler audit.
arguments: set -e; echo '== VCS selection =='; type -a vcs || true; printf 'VCS_HOME=%s\n' "${VCS_HOME:-UNSET}"; if [ -n "${VCS_HOME:-}" ]; then ls -ld "$VCS_HOME" "$VCS_HOME/bin" 2>&1 || true; ls -l "$VCS_HOME/bin/vcs1" 2>&1 || true; fi; echo '== installed vcs1 candidates =='; find /opt/Synopsys -maxdepth 6 -type f -name vcs1 -print 2>/dev/null | sort

vcs-linux64-smoke.description: Read-only VCS compiler launch probe with the installed linux64 architecture.

uvm-qam-ofdm-bittrue.description: Compile and run the MATLAB-quantized 10,240-sample QAM-OFDM UVM bit-true testcase.
